verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's H200 page publishes capacity (141GB), memory type (HBM3e) and bandwidth (4.8 TB/s). A community post corroborates the HBM3e stack configuration. The story asks for full specs, but no bus width appears anywhere, and the page mixes SXM and NVL variants without clearly tying these figures to the SXM part. Missing for 10: memory bus width, an SXM-specific spec table, and independent bandwidth corroboration.
